description: Add a brand guideline, as Brand Control, Writing, Brand Guidelines does: a rule the writer follows in every article from now on, with its type, what to avoid and what to write instead (300 characters each). It starts switched on; set_brand_guideline_active turns it off. Returns the new guidelineId.

avoid.description: What the writer should avoid (300 characters max)

instead.description: What to write instead (300 characters max)

type.description: What the guideline covers: tone, terminology, topic, style or factual

name: add_brand_guideline
